1: Allah un musalsal hawaon ki qasam khata hai, jo ghode ki ayaal ki tarah hain.
2: Aur woh un shadeed chalne wali hawaon ki bhi qasam khata hai.
3: Aur un hawaon ki bhi jo baarish ko bikherti hain.
4: Aur woh un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo us cheez ke saath utarte hain jo haqq aur batil mein farq karti hai.
5: Aur woh un farishton ki bhi qasam khata hai jo wahi le kar utarte hain.
6: Woh wahi le kar utarte hain Allah ki taraf se ek darawe ke tor par taake us ka uzr poora ho jaaye, aur logon ko Allah ke azaab se darane ke liye.
7: Beshak woh dobara uthna, hisaab aur badla jis ka tum se waada kiya gaya yaqeenan hone wala hai.
8: Jab woh hoga, to sitare achanak apni chamak kho denge, aur un ki roshni bujh jaayegi.
9: Aasman achanak phat jayega us se farishton ke utarne ki wajah se.
10: Pahaad achanak apni jagahon se ukhad diye jaayenge, aur unhein tukde tukde kar diya jayega yahan tak ke woh gard ke zarre jaise ho jaayenge.
11: Aur Rasool ek muqarrar waqt ke liye jama kiye jaayenge.
12: Ek bade din ke liye jo taala gaya hai, taake woh apni qaumon ke khilaf gawahi dein.
13: Bandon ke darmiyan judai ke din ke liye, taake sachcha jhoote se waazeh ho jaaye, aur khush-naseeb badnaseeb se.
14: Aey Rasool! Aap ko judai ke din ke baare mein kya maaloom?
15: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un jhutlane walon ke liye hoga jin ne us ko jhutlaya jo Rasool Allah ki taraf se laaye.
16: Kya Hum ne pehli qaumon ko halak nahin kiya jab unhon ne Allah ke saath kufr kiya aur apne Rasoolon ko jhutlaya?
17: Phir Hum ne jhutlane walon ke peeche baad walon ko duniya mein bheja, aur phir unhein waise hi halak kar diya jaise Hum ne un se pehle walon ko halak kiya.
18: Jaise Hum ne un qaumon ko halak kiya, Hum un mujrimon ko halak karenge jo us ko jhutlate hain jo Muhammad ﷺ laaye hain.
19: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo Allah ke us darawe ko jhutlate hain jo us ne mujrimon ke azaab ke baare mein diya.
20: Aey logo! Kya Hum ne tumhein ek haqeer paani ki thodi si miqdaar se paida nahin kiya, yani ek nutfe se?
21: Phir Hum ne us haqeer paani ko ek mehfooz jagah mein rakha, yani aurat ke rehm mein.
22: Ek maaloom muddat ke liye, yani hamal ke arse ke liye.
23: Phir Hum ne us bachche ki sifaat, us ka naseeb, us ka rang wagera tay kiye, pas main in sab par bohat qaadir hoon.
24: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo Allah ki qudrat ko jhutlate hain.
25: Kya Hum ne zameen ko tamam logon ko thaamne ke laayaq nahin banaya?
26: Woh un ke zindon ko thaamti hai unhein jeene aur use abaad karne de kar, aur un ke murdon ko un ko us mein dafan hone de kar.
27: Hum ne us par buland, jamay hue pahaad bhi rakhe jo use hilne se rokte hain. Aur aey logo! Hum tumhein peene ke liye meetha paani dete hain. Pas jis ne yeh sab paida kiya woh tumhein dobara uthane se aajiz nahin.
28: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo Allah ki niyamaton ko jhutlate hain.
29: Un logon se, jin ne us ko jhutlaya jo un ke Rasool laaye, kaha jayega: 'Aey jhutlane walo! Us azaab ki taraf chalo jis ka tum inkar karte the.'
30: 'Jahannam ki aag ke dhuen ke us saaye ki taraf chalo, jo teen hisson mein bata hua hai.'
31: 'Us mein saaye ki koi thandak nahin, aur na woh Jahannam ki aag ke sholay ya us ki garmi ko tum tak pahunchne se rokta hai.'
32: Beshak Jahannam ki aag aise chingare phenkti hai, har chingara apni jisaamat mein ek mahal jaisa hai.
33: Goya woh chingare jo woh phenkti hai apni siyahi aur apni jisaamat mein kaale pahaad hain.
34: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un jhutlane walon ke liye hoga jin ne us ko jhutlaya jo Rasool Allah ki taraf se laaye.
35: Yeh ek aisa din hai jis mein woh bilkul baat na kar sakenge.
36: Aur na unhein ijazat di jaayegi ke apne Rubb ke saamne apne kufr aur buraiyon ke uzr pesh karein.
37: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo is din ki khabar ko jhutlate hain.
38: Yeh makhlooq ke darmiyan judai ka din hai; Hum ne tumhein aur pehli qaumon ko ek hi maidan mein jama kiya.
39: Pas agar tumhare paas koi tadbeer hai jise tum mere azaab se apne aap ko bachane ke liye kar sako, to use kar dekho.
40: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo judai ke din ko jhutlate hain.
41: Beshak jo log apne Rubb se darte hain us ke ahkam baja laa kar aur un cheezon se bach kar jin ki us ne ijazat nahin di, woh Jannat ke darakhton ke phaile hue saaye mein honge, aur meethe, behte chashmon ke darmiyan.
42: Aur un phalon ke darmiyan jinhein khane ki woh khwahish karenge.
43: Aur un se kaha jayega: 'Paak cheezon mein se khao, aur ek paak, bagair kharaabi wala peene ko piyo, duniya mein apne nek aamaal ke badle mein.'
44: Jaise Hum ne tumhein yeh badla diya, Hum un tamam logon ko badla dete hain jo nek aamaal karte hain.
45: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo us ko jhutlate hain jo Allah ne parhezgaron ke liye tayyar kiya.
46: Aur jhutlane walon se kaha jayega: 'Khao aur duniya mein thodi der ke liye zindagi ki maze-dar cheezon se faida uthao; tum beshak mujrim ho apne Allah ke saath kufr aur us ke Rasoolon ko jhutlane ki wajah se.'
47: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un logon ke liye hoga jo badle ke din apne badle ko jhutlate hain.
48: Jab in jhutlane walon se kaha jaata hai: 'Allah ke liye namaz parho', to woh us se dua nahin karte.
49: Us din halaakat, azaab aur nuqsan un jhutlane walon ke liye hoga jin ne us ko jhutlaya jo Rasool Allah ki taraf se laaye.
50: Pas jab woh is Quran par iman nahin laate jo un ke Rubb ki taraf se nazil kiya gaya, to woh kis doosri baat par iman layenge?
